description: In 19th-century France, ex-prisoner Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman), pursued for many years by ruthless policeman Javert (Russell Crowe), agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.

title: The Revenant
description: In 1823, fur trapper Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) treks through the snowy wilderness to track down John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy), a member of his hunting team who killed his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and left him for dead.

title: Sinners
description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

title: Red Sparrow
description: Dominika Egorova learns to use her mind and body as a weapon after joining a secret intelligence service. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust.

title: Flight Risk
description: A U.S. marshal boards a small plane to transfer a government witness to New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions start to rise as not everyone on the flight is who they appear to be.

title: Dead of Winter
description: A grief-stricken widow stops by a remote cabin after getting lost on the back roads of Minnesota in the middle of winter. She soon finds herself in a desperate fight for survival as she encounters a murderous couple holding a young woman hostage.

title: Death of a Unicorn
description: A weekend retreat has deadly consequences when a father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route, and his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature's miraculous curative properties.

title: The End of Oak Street
description: A mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports a neighborhood to someplace unknown. The Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: The Bride!
description: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

title: Supergirl
description: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Supergirl reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
description: Author A.A. Milne finds inspiration from his son to write Winnie-the-Pooh and The House at Pooh Corner in the 1920s. His family soon becomes swept up in the success of the books, while the tales bring hope and comfort to postwar England.

title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
description: Ten-year-old Gloria and her grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home.
